title: Concept: KYC document reference in a response
description: A KYC block with a document reference value in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The reference ties a real identity document to the account, and with the document type it is enough to impersonate the customer at a branch or in a call centre.
applicability: Onboarding status, profile and branch-service pages.
risk: A document number is a durable identity credential; it survives password changes and device resets.
